hooks.name: Personal Data Pre-Commit Guard
hooks.description: Enforces NFR-3.2 (the repository must never contain real personal data). Before a tool runs a `git commit`, it inspects the staged files and blocks the commit (exit 2) if any staged path matches the personal-data patterns: *.personal.json, *.private.json, anything under personal-data/, profile-data/ or private/, or files named like profile-history / url-history. Clearly-marked demo data (examples/*, *.sample.*, *.example.*) is allowed. If the tool call is not a git commit the guard is a no-op and the action proceeds.
